items.title: Lendeborg Tip-Off Pack + trade-in auction
items.promise: 1,450 Tip-Off Packs at $10, pre-order until 7 PM ET, with Yaxel Lendeborg's /5 and /500 Rookie Debut, LaMelo's /99 Timberwolves debut and Haliburton's /199 return inside. Trade-in auction until 7 PM ET: bid any NBA Rookie Debut, or a Haliburton/LaMelo Top Shot Debut, Rare or better. Top 25 bidders win 2 packs each.
items.note: Pre-order closed and packs were delivered on Nov 4.

items.title: Points Store: changes coming
items.promise: When Road to the Ring ended (Jun 26), Top Shot said unused points would roll over to the next run, with more details to come. On Oct 21, Top Shot said the Points Store isn't gone: they're working with partners on changes they believe will be beneficial, and didn't want to rush it back. More info to come.
items.note: "It's not done… working with our partners on a few changes… There'll be more information to come. Hang tight… There's some cool stuff." Matt (Vinyls), Coffee with Coultin, Oct 21 (58:51)
items.source: Top Shot blog (Jun 17, 2026) + Coffee with Coultin (Oct 21, 58:51)

items.title: Top Shot This: Luka Dončić
items.promise: Trade in Luka Moments all week (Nov 2 to 8). Every $10 traded in earns a pack of his 52-point, 10-assist night. No cap. Packs delivered Nov 9, with /25, /10 and /5 parallels to chase.
items.note: A trade-in event that also reduces supply. We'll check off pack delivery on Nov 9.

items.title: October: a month full of giveaways
items.promise: Top Shot said October would be a month full of giveaways.
items.note: 4 giveaways spotted in October: two $100 Dapper Credit prizes (Oct 1, winners Oct 5), a Jersey Swap Pack (Oct 21), a Darryn Peterson Tip-Off Pack (Oct 22) and a Cameron Boozer Tip-Off Pack (Oct 31). Giveaways happened, but fewer than a full month's worth. Did we miss one? Tell @VC15Tracker and we'll update it.

items.title: Dapper maintenance and upgrades
items.promise: Up to 48 hours of maintenance for better performance and future improvements, finishing Thursday Oct 29, 9 AM PT.
items.note: Back online Oct 29. A bit slow at first while things warm up.

items.title: Referral program: public referral links
items.promise: Anyone can earn 10% on referred sales (Elite partners 15%), with tracking tools for referrers.
items.note: We couldn't find the referral link in the app yet. Feedback sent to the team.

items.title: Moments saved forever on IPFS
items.promise: Roadmap promise ('Your Moments, Forever'): moment videos stored so they can be verified independently, without Top Shot.
items.note: Delivered for every moment from every series, a request the community asked for loudly and repeatedly.

items.title: Signature Series rookie 1-of-1s
items.promise: Roadmap promise: autographed, custom-inscribed 1-of-1 rookie moments.
items.note: Launched with Flagg and Knueppel in packs. Top Shot expanded 'My Top Fan' from 4 rookies to 10.

items.title: Team leaderboard airdrops (at least 3)
items.promise: Roadmap promise: Rare or Legendary airdrops to top team leaderboard collectors at least 3 times in the season.
items.note: Snapshots on Feb 11, Mar 11 and May 13.

items.title: Seasonal Favorite Team leaderboards
items.promise: Roadmap promise: seasonal team leaderboards in December, with 3+ airdrops.
items.note: Live by early January, a few weeks after the December target.

items.title: 'Why This Matters' in big announcements
items.promise: Mailbag promise: add a 'Why This Matters' section to major product announcements.
items.note: First seen in the Jan 12 athlete partnerships post.

items.title: The Wheel is back
items.promise: 'You asked, and it's back.' The Wheel spins every Monday to pick the Flash Challenge stat.

items.title: IPFS IDs on-chain + pin-your-own guide
items.promise: Next steps after IPFS: put each moment's IPFS ID into its on-chain record on Flow, and share instructions so collectors can pin their own moments.

items.title: Players of the Week rewards + MVP Pack
items.promise: Weekly East and West Players of the Week as Flash Challenge rewards from Oct 26. Lock every one in a month for the Player of the Month pack; collect them all for the MVP Pack at season end.

items.title: A Signature Series 1-of-1 for every partnered athlete
items.promise: Every partnered Top Shot Athlete gets a Signature Series 1-of-1 this season, with more partners announced as the season goes.

items.title: Fast Break Finals + NBA Finals suite
items.promise: Top 50 in any Classic or Pro run qualifies for the invite-only Fast Break Finals, Mar 30 to Apr 11. Classic Final top 10 win a seat in an NBA Finals suite. Pro Final cash prizes: 'details coming.'

items.title: Origins drop and Christmas drop
items.promise: Origins drop Wed, Dec 16 and a Christmas drop Fri, Dec 25.

items.title: Rookie Debut drop
items.promise: Drop Wed, Nov 11 with early access Nov 5 and public pre-orders Nov 10. Case $2,500 · Box $250 · Collector Pack $39.

items.title: Season Tip-Off challenge reward
items.promise: Lock a moment of every Season Tip-Off player by Jan 4, 11 PM ET for the Jalen Brunson banner-night moment, minted to the exact number of finishers.

items.title: Exclusive packs for completed Rookie Debut and Base sets
items.promise: Completing Rookie Debut and Base Set earns an exclusive pack once the sets close. Fresh Threads closes after the trade deadline with its own reward.

items.title: Season-long rewards: Squad Goals, Blue Chip, Rookie Yearbook
items.promise: Squad Goals /10 Ultimate to the top 10 of every team's seasonal leaderboard (snapshot Jul 1, 2027). Blue Chip /3 and Rookie Yearbook /26 after the All-Rookie teams are named. Constellations /99 trade-ins for every 2027 All-Star.

items.title: WNBA Finals drop
items.promise: A WNBA Finals drop (Playoffs, Semifinals and Finals sets) once a champion is crowned. Priority access details 'to come.'

feedback.title: Make the referral link easy to find
feedback.request: Add a "Refer & Earn" link in the menu or profile, with a copy-link button and a page showing referrals and earnings.
feedback.note: Sent through Top Shot's feedback channel.

feedback.title: Show new users they're joining with an invite
feedback.request: When someone opens a referral link, show a banner like "You're joining with [username]'s invite" through sign-up, so both sides know it counted.
feedback.note: Sent through Top Shot's feedback channel.

feedback.title: Reduce supply of older moments
feedback.request: Collectors want ways to retire older moments, such as trade-in and crafting events, so the moments they hold get scarcer.
feedback.note: Related: Top Shot This trade-in events, starting with Luka (Nov 2 to 8).
